specs.title: Business hours and blackout dates
specs.why: The availability engine cannot compute slots without a source of truth for opening times.
specs.scope: Per-tenant weekly schedule with multiple windows per weekday, plus date-specific overrides.
tasks: Add `tests/hours.test.ts` covering multi-window days and blackouts
acceptance: Different hours per weekday persist and are verified by `pnpm test`
A blackout date causes `getOpenWindows()` to return an empty array

specs.title: Manual booking entry
specs.why: Owners record walk-ins from day one, and it forces the double-booking constraint early.
specs.scope: Owner adds a booking from the dashboard, choosing or creating a client. A database constraint prevents overlaps.
tasks: Add `prisma/migrations/`: add a Postgres exclusion constraint on `(staffId, tstzrange)`
Add `lib/audit.ts`: write an `AuditLog` row on create
acceptance: An overlapping booking for the same staff is rejected, verified by `pnpm test`
The created booking appears in `/app/calendar` on reload
